name: ScreenTinker
summary: Ultra-low-power digital signage client with 8MB PSRAM caching, multi-zone layouts, System Menu, and captive portal.
description: ScreenTinker turns your reTerminal Sticky into an ultra-low-power, wireless digital signage display. Features direct 1-bit SSD1677 bitstream streaming, 8MB PSRAM in-memory frame cache for instant button browsing, multi-zone layout rendering (switch between Fullscreen and Multi-Zone via System Menu, Captive Portal, or WebSerial), interactive on-screen System Menu, hardware power-off latch release, shutdown screen with scannable QR Code and GitHub link, server-coordinated deep sleep with ETag caching, and smartphone Captive Portal.

compatibility.notes: Tested on Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky production hardware with 3.97-inch E-Paper and ESP32-S3.

notes.title: USB Connection & Web Flashing
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB-C data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Dual Onboarding Setup
notes.description: After flashing, connect your smartphone to the 'ScreenTinker-Setup' Wi-Fi hotspot to configure Wi-Fi, Server URL, and Layout Mode via the popup setup portal, or use tools/sticky-installer.html via USB with WebSerial Config Protocol (WSCP) v1.0.

notes.title: Interactive System Menu & Power Off
notes.description: Hold the OK button for 1.5 seconds to open the on-screen System Menu (Back, Layout Mode toggle, Power Off with QR code, Factory Reset). Navigate with UP/DOWN and confirm with OK.

notes.title: 6-Digit Pairing Code
notes.description: Once Wi-Fi is connected, the Sticky will display a 6-digit pairing code on screen. In your ScreenTinker dashboard, click '+ Add Display' and enter the code.
